verdict.rationale: A payments and commerce platform could plausibly ship an in-product AI assistant, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows ways for external agents to reach PayPal: an MCP server used from third-party MCP clients, an agent toolkit for building your own agents, and checkout support for ChatGPT and Gemini. These are developer building blocks or host-platform assistants, not a built-in assistant users can delegate tasks to inside PayPal.
